sites.rationale: The ledger line from PMC8878318 explicitly names the junction as between Y460 and N461 of full-length human TRPC5. Python verification confirms: seq[459]='Y' and seq[460]='N', exactly matching the paper. Both residues fall within the computed extracellular span 455–476 (ECL2, between TM4 ending at 454 and TM5 starting at 477). Distance from TM4 C-terminus: 460−454=6 aa; distance from TM5 N-terminus: 477−460=17 aa — both well above the ≥3 aa minimum. The insert (GGGGS-DogTag-GGGGS, ~33 aa total) was tolerated in a membrane-anchored, full-length construct used for extracellular surface labeling, satisfying all constraints. The ALFA tag (~15–23 aa with GS linkers) is comparable in size to the DogTag insert used here and would be accommodated at the same junction. Full-length human TRPC5 (pcDNA4-TRPC5-DogTag-SYFP2) was expressed in mammalian cells with a DogTag peptide (DIPATYEFTDGKHYITNEPIPPK, ~23 aa) flanked by GGGGS linkers inserted between Y460 and N461 in ECL2 (extracellular loop between TM4 and TM5, topology span 455–476). The construct was used for site-specific surface labeling studies, demonstrating the tag is accessible on the extracellular face. [validation: surface_only; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: For pcDNA4-TRPC5-DogTag-SYFP2, DogTag (underlined), flanked by a glycine-serine linkers (GGGGS DIPATYEFTDGKHYITNEPIPPK GGGGS) was introduced between Y460 and N461 of human TRPC5 by site-directed mutagenesis with Q5 High-Fidelity DNA polymerase (NEB).

literature_notes: Only one ledger line was provided, grounding a single site at Y460/N461 in ECL2 of TRPC5. No other extracellular insertions (N-terminal, other loops, or other ECL junctions) are supported by the ledger. The construct also carries a C-terminal SYFP2 fusion, but that is intracellular (C-terminus is in the intracellular span 625–973) and therefore not proposed as an extracellular tag site. No other ledger lines name additional junctions in ECL1 (385–404), ECL3 (536–603), or the short ECL between TM1–TM2 (338), so no additional sites are reported.
